product_metadata.title: Door Draft Stopper, Inflatable Draft Stopper for Bottom of Door SHMILY Cover Gap From 0.25" To 1.80". Dust-Proof, Draft-Proof, Water-Proof, Winter-Proof, Block Light, Block Noise(Black 32" Inflatable)
features: 【Dust-proof Draft-proof Water-proof Winter-proof Block-light Block-noise】Dust and Rainwater may often stain your floor; Air conditioner may not keep your room cold or hot; Light and Noise may affect your sleep quality; Little animals may go through the door gap to visit your home. If you still cannot solve these problems after trying various methods, maybe you should try SHMILY. The rigorous design and refined production of SHMILY make Door Draft Stopper achieve ideal effects in all respects.

【High-quality waterproof PVC material】SHMILY Door Draft Stopper is made of high-quality waterproof PVC material which has excellent tensile strength, tear strength, elasticity, toughness and bending resistance. These characteristics make the quality of SHMILY Door Draft Stopper very reliable. In addition, SHMILY Door Draft Stopper has excellent water resistance, ultraviolet resistance, high temperature resistance and low temperature resistance, so it is fit for a variety of environments.

【Cover door gaps from 0.25" to 1.80" & Fit for all types of doors and floors】The diameter of this Door Draft Stopper is 2.00 inches, which is larger than most Door Draft Stoppers and enough to cover door gaps from 0.25 inches to 1.80 inches. In addition, the soft texture and the high wear resistance allow it to be used on carpet, tile, marble, wood or vinyl without making any scratches on the floor. Therefore, it's fit for your front door, back door, bedroom door, kitchen door or bathroom door.

【Easy to install & Easy to use】This Door Draft Stopper is different from other Door Draft Stoppers in that it is inflatable. So all you need to do is inflate it and push it into the door gap. You don't need to install this Door Draft Stopper with nail or tape, so it will not damage your door or leave any scratches or traces of double-sided tape on your door. SHMILY Door Draft Stopper moves with the door, there is no need to bend over to reposition it when opening and closing the door.

【Saves energy & Saves money】When the air conditioner in your room is working, SHMILY Door Draft Stopper will be the right assistant of the air conditioner which is helpful to prevent the convection of indoor air and outdoor air. It can not only keep your room at a comfortable temperature, but also effectively reduce the waste of energy for you. In addition, SHMILY Door Draft Stopper is durable and easy to clean. If dirty, you just rinse and dry it, so you can use it once and once again.
